sloka: गुणवान् वा परजनः स्वजनो निर्गुणो ऽपि वा।निर्गुणः स्वजनः श्रेयान् यः परः पर एव सः ।। ६.८७.१५ ।।
transliteration: guṇavān vā parajanaḥ svajano nirguṇo 'pi vā।nirguṇaḥ svajanaḥ śreyān yaḥ paraḥ para eva saḥ ।। 6.87.15 ।।

translations.english: "Even if others are virtuous and your own people are not virtuous also one should seek the refuge of one's own people. Strangers are always strangers."
